sloka: तस्मिन् संतप्यमाने तु विश्वामित्रे महामुनौ ।संतापः सुमहान् आसीत् सुराणाम् वासवस्य च ॥१-६३-२५॥
transliteration: tasmin saṁtapyamāne tu viśvāmitre mahāmunau ।saṁtāpaḥ sumahān āsīt surāṇām vāsavasya ca ॥1-63-25॥

translations.english: When the mighty asetic Viswamitra was peforming penance, the gods as well as Indra got deeply perturbed.
